-- Channel of integers with fixed capacity. `sent` counts accepted sends.
type Chan = { cap: int, sent: int }

-- Make an empty channel that holds up to `cap` integers.
open_chan(cap: int) -> Chan =
  pre cap >= 0
  post out.cap == cap
  post out.sent == 0
  ex open_chan(2).sent == 0
  Chan(cap: cap, sent: 0)

-- Try a non-blocking send. Returns True if accepted, False if the channel is full.
try_send(var c: Chan, v: int) -> bool =
  post out == False or c.sent <= c.cap
  ex try_send(open_chan(0), 1) == False
  if c.sent < c.cap
    c.sent += 1
    True
  else
    False

-- Send each element of `xs` without blocking, stopping at the first full channel.
-- Returns how many sends were accepted.
accepted(cap: int, xs: List[int]) -> int uses nondet =
  pre cap >= 0
  post out >= 0
  post out <= xs.len()
  ex accepted(0, [1, 2]) == 0
  ex accepted(3, []) == 0
  var c = open_chan(cap)
  var n = 0
  for x in xs
    if not try_send(&c, x)
      break
    n += 1
  n

test_accepted() =
  assert accepted(0, [1, 2]) == 0
  assert accepted(3, []) == 0
  assert accepted(2, [1, 2, 3]) == 2
  assert accepted(5, [1, 2]) == 2
